name: Starlit Glacier
author: Nickalopogas
description: Land on the edge of the platform at 63% and then fly through the saws right after it. If you fly too high after them, you will go into a yellow gravity and a normal size portal. You can still make it past the spike wall if you're regular size or upside-down, it's just more awkward, so it's best to just avoid them. Be sure to start holding at around 96% to avoid the spike wall at the end.
